reason: B is the stronger proposal because the HEFO-supported single-site intervention is substantive, mechanistically plausible, directly supported by cited Pd₁@HEFO evidence, and testable against an appropriate oxide-supported nanoparticle baseline using activity, PGM-normalized performance, aging, and structural measurements. A relies on an unsupported 20–30% loading reduction and assumes isolated Pt sites will improve all CO, hydrocarbon, and NOx conversions despite possible ensemble-site requirements, while providing no prior evidence.
